BUG-2732 (BUG-b6b1278890774ef993d2ebc327862470-493) — PARTIAL. The test covers pruning and the live-holder refusal. It leaves immediate admission with stale receipts present unverified.
BUG-b6b1278890774ef993d2ebc327862470-493.AC1 — unverified. Pinned landed source inspection confirms receipts() prunes confirmed dead or reused PID identities before the busy decision. The test never attempts admission with stale receipts as the only holders.
BUG-b6b1278890774ef993d2ebc327862470-493.AC2 — unverified. The implementer reported a passing lane run of `cargo test -p aida-cli-lib bug2732_manual_train_releases_stale_legacy_receipts`. The test observes a live auto-train refusal and reused-PID pruning, then succeeds only after both stale entries are gone. The supplied untraced-criteria list names AC1 and AC2, and the diff adds only the spec-level trace.
Reviewed the whole landed diff on protected base ef906ec7464cf1b3100c4383085280c203722941 (landed tree 003fd914bc3a12da06f2798b3623a383fe002212) while attesting the original head. Main is four commits ahead. Its changes in admission_owner.rs leave the tested stale-receipt path intact, and neither finding depends on those changes. At review time, exact-head fast gates and the merge-hold gate passed, fast compile was pending, and the full test shards were skipped. No local tests or builds were run.
